name: LU-VE S.p.A.
summary: LU-VE S.p.A. engages in the manufacture and sale of heat exchangers and air cooled equipment in Italy and internationally. It operates through SBU Cooling Systems and SBU Components systems. The company offers air cooled condensers, air coolers, CO2 gas coolers, liquid coolers, OEM heat exchangers, thermos glass doors, and IOT solutions. It also provides heat exchangers used in various fields of activity, such as clothes dryers, refrigerated transport, air conditioning for railways and large scale vehicles, compressed air machines, and other industrial applications; and air cooled products for use in refrigeration of engines for the generation of power and general industrial processes.
